name: Pride
overview: Scripture reveals pride as a dangerous elevation of self above God and others, as seen when the people challenged Moses and Aaron, questioning their authority despite the LORD's presence among them (Numbers 16:3). God's supremacy over all powers is affirmed, reminding believers that He alone is God and worthy of honor (Deuteronomy 4:35; Exodus 18:11). The Lord warns against forgetting Him and His commandments, linking pride to spiritual failure and judgment (Deuteronomy 8:11; Leviticus 26:19). True faith calls for humility, recognizing God's deliverance and sovereignty rather than lifting oneself up in pride.
